# Bantu The People

> Professional e-waste recycling in South Africa. Free pickup, certified data destruction, and compliance reporting for businesses and households.

Bantu The People collects, processes, and recycles electronic waste from across South Africa. ISO 14001 certified, with secure data destruction and CSR/impact reporting for corporate clients.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, impact, and how to schedule a pickup.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on e-waste recycling, sustainability, and South African compliance.
- [Directory](/directory): Certified recycling centers across South Africa.
- [Tools](/tools): Pickup scheduling, quote calculator, device value estimator, impact dashboard, locations, and certificates.

## Tools

- [Schedule a Pickup](/tools/pickup): Book free e-waste collection.
- [Get a Quote](/tools/quote): Pricing for collection and processing.
- [Device Value](/tools/value): Estimate residual value of devices.
- [Impact](/tools/impact): View environmental impact metrics.
- [Locations](/tools/locations): Find drop-off and processing locations.
- [Certificate](/tools/certificate): Download data destruction & recycling certificates.
